assistant_outcomes.text: **Root, then cut.** Most of the stack is cairn stones stacked after the first useful move. Lessig means: keep the law that actually binds behavior; delete the ceremony that only *describes* it.

You’re right. We built scaffolding around scaffolding. The ritual is small; the costume got fat. --- ### Root ritual (three laws only) | Law | Plain English | Where it lives | |-----|----------------|----------------| | **1. File the day** | When a session ends, write what mattered so chat death doesn’t erase you | residual + registry + tip | | **2. Card first** | List face = title + blurb + few bullets. Full dump only on open | session_card / registry row | | **3. Strike when it matters** | Truth-only, personal impact, multi-frame, consent, concrete moves + short commit | strike-chord skill |
Checking how PDF/derived vs live API paths work now so the answer matches the stack.

**Yes.** You’re describing the right stack. Mag half-has it and still violates it every time it eagerly writes PDFs. --- ### What you mean by layered (correct) | Layer | Job | When it runs | |-------|-----|----------------| | **1. Truth** | Structured facts on disk (or a real DB later): residual, registry, tip, KPI | Always on session end / event | | **2. Query** | Dashboard dropdowns / API: “this session exists → pull card / residual / stats” | On request, real time | | **3. Render** | PDF, charts, 3D, pretty pack | Only when a human asks for a print/export/view | **Law:** store once as data.
Implementing data-first layering: residual always, PDF/visual only on explicit export.
Implementing the data-first path across hooks, export API, and dashboard.

**Done.** Data is the product; PDF/visual are export stickers. ### Law now | Layer | What runs | |-------|-----------| | **SessionEnd** | residual + card + tip only (`pdf=False`, no visual) | | **Dashboard** | stats from residual (tension, theme, msgs, …) | | **Export** | PDF/visual only when you ask | ### Code - `summarize_session(..., pdf=False, visual=False)` default - Hooks / catch-up: no PDF/visual - `brief`: no auto visual - Charts only when exporting PDF - PDF → `derived/` only (no flat dual-write by default) - `POST /api/v1/export` `{session_id, pdf?, visual?}` - Session detail: **stat
Checking what the local dashboard already serves so we can ground the board design in reality.

**Yes — that’s the right product shape.** You’re already halfway there; the missing piece is one modular board fed by residual, not more PDFs or 3D. --- ### Are we running one locally? **Yes.** Mag lab is up (`:8765`, KPI returns 200). That’s the local web dashboard: sessions, operate, board, detail stats, export-on-demand PDF. There is **no separate analytics DB** yet. “Database” today is: - `residual/*.json` + `registry.jsonl` + tip/kpi - served by **HTTP API** (`/api/v1/registry`, `/sessions/{id}`, residual, kpi) That’s enough for Data-Studio-style panels.
